capability: Draw a link only where the source shows it
title: Draw only links you can show.

hook.picture: Close on the whale drawing a neat diagram, adding an arrow between every pair of boxes so it all looks connected. A pod follows one arrow to nowhere.
hook.words: I drew it neat. All boxes joined.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The diagram looked tidy. Half the arrows were guesses.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: researcher reviewing an agent architecture diagram

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three pods take three guessed arrows, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Three ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Real and guessed arrows look the same.

stakes.body: Readers trust links nobody built, so reviews, plans and agents act on wiring that does not exist.

solution_hint: Draw a link only where it's written.

metaphor.body: The whale holds the source document as it draws. A link goes in only where the source shows it; guessed arrows fade. A core box with no outgoing links is left alone, because that is what the source says.

steps.picture: The whale reads the source card and draws a teal dashed link only where it shows one. The guessed arrows fade out.
steps.words: A link goes in only with a source.
steps.sound: A pen tick per sourced link.

steps.picture: The core box ends up with no outgoing links. The whale starts to add one to make it look tidy, stops, and leaves it alone.
steps.words: The core box stays alone. That's honest.
steps.sound: A tick lifted mid-stroke, then rest.

steps.picture: Push-in. Six known-missing pieces are drawn as terracotta dashed links, each with a small note that it is named in the source as not built yet.
The result settles into layers: rules at the top, then parts, surfaces, and named next.
steps.words: Each link is a seam with a source.

real_case.claim: The OAH digest lattice draws edges only where the source shows them, in four strata (L0 law to L3 named next), with six named unbuilt items as terracotta. The raw ingest (cap 400) hairballs in 3D.

honest_limit.picture: A real connection exists between two boxes (a faint ghost thread), but the docs never mention it, so the map leaves it out.
honest_limit.words: If the docs never said it, it's missing.

not_this.body: Written down is not the same as real.

ending_pattern.body: The diagram is redrawn in the same spot with fewer arrows, the core box standing alone, and gaps in their own colour; every pod arrives somewhere real.
ending_pattern.callback: The arrow to nowhere from bar 2 is gone, and the pod that failed there now arrives, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Every link on your map needs a source.

beats.words: I drew it neat. All boxes joined.

beats.picture: A pod follows one of the arrows and reaches a box that is not really joined. It answers with a copper ✕ chip.
A second pod takes a different guessed arrow. Another ✕.
beats.words: Then someone followed an arrow to nowhere.

beats.picture: The whale looks at its neat, crowded diagram. Hold.
Half a bar of stillness, then SERIES.open and the title.
beats.camera: still (half a bar of stillness first)

beats.picture: Pull back. The diagram is crowded with arrows, all the same ink; you can't tell which were seen and which were guessed.
beats.sound: Room tone, then the problem motif once.

beats.picture: Three pods take three guessed arrows, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Three ✕.
beats.words: Real and guessed arrows look the same.

beats.picture: All motion stops. A source card ghosts in beside the whale's pen.
beats.words: Draw a link only where it's written.
beats.sound: The first clean signature: a pen tick on paper.

beats.picture: Wide. The real harness map: four layers, teal links only where the docs show them, six terracotta gaps at the top layer. The card fades in on clean paper.
beats.words: Real review of an agent system map.

beats.picture: Beside it, the raw everything-ingested map: a tangled hairball. It dims away.
beats.words: The raw dump was an unreadable hairball.

beats.picture: A real connection exists between two boxes (a faint ghost thread), but the docs never mention it, so the map leaves it out.
beats.words: If the docs never said it, it's missing.
beats.sound: The tick plays once and stays unresolved.

beats.picture: Slow push into the ghost thread the map can't show.
beats.words: Written down is not the same as real.
beats.camera: one slow push to the thing that slipped

beats.picture: Same close framing as bar 1. The whale draws again: fewer arrows, the core box alone, gaps in terracotta. Pods follow teal links and answer ✓.
Every pod arrives somewhere real. Spark.
The honest map, the whale breathing beside it.
beats.words: Every link on your map needs a source.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the settled chart ground.
beats.sound: Lockup sting, then the room tone tail.

score_self.reason: It's distinctive and true to the source ('Do not invent links'). The lonely core box is a memorable honest beat, and the limit is a real blind spot. The only risk is that the four layers in the card are a count, not a printed number.
